text: つかまえたと　おもったのに！

patterns.name: 〜のに
patterns.explanation: のに means 'even though' and, left hanging at the end, shows disappointment. おもったのに = 'and I thought so, too!'

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.span: つかまえたと　おもった
patterns.explanation: と before おもう wraps up what was thought. つかまえたと　おもった = 'I thought I had caught it'.
